output.subject: We have received your complaint about your auto loan credit reporting
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for contacting us, and for setting out the details so clearly. We have received your complaint and want to confirm what you have told us.

You told us that your auto loan was reported to the credit bureaus as 30 days late for August. You mentioned that you made the payment on 8/7, two days before the due date, and that you have a payment confirmation and a bank statement showing the payment cleared. You have asked us to correct the reporting with all three credit bureaus.

We understand how worrying it can be to see something unexpected on your credit report, and we're sorry for the concern this has caused.

A specialist team is now reviewing your complaint, and we will respond to you within 10 business days. If you have the bank statement you mentioned to hand, please keep it available in case it is helpful.

Kind regards,

Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Customer included their SSN and date of birth in an unsecured email; decide whether to advise them not to send these by email and whether the message needs special handling.
The draft does not repeat the payment confirmation number, SSN, DOB or phone number; add the confirmation reference only if you decide it is appropriate.
Verify the payment date of 8/7 against the August due date and the loan's payment history.
Decide whether the credit bureau reporting should be corrected; the draft makes no commitment.
Decide whether to request a copy of the customer's bank statement; the draft only asks them to keep it available.
Customer's preferred contact appears to be email; a mobile number was also provided.
